newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Slovenia seeks bids for new credit.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Slovenia seeks bids for new credit.

text.p: LONDON, October 31 (LPC) - The Republic of Slovenia is requesting banks to bid for a new 50 million mark bank loan, according to market sources.
Bidding is expected to be very competitive and Slovenia should acheive better pricing than in its last syndicated loan, bankers said.

In April 1996, the Republic signed a seven year $60 million term loan arranged by Credit Suisse, Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank, JP Morgan and Sumitomo Bank. That credit was priced at 40 bps over LIBOR for the first four years, rising to 50 bps until maturity.
Slovenia currently has foreign currency credit ratings of A3 from Moody's Investment Service and A from Standard and Poor's.
